emailTemplate.subject: Login from a new location
emailTemplate.body:
Hello,

We noticed a login to your {APP_NAME} account from a new location:

{ALERT_INFO}

If this wasn't you, you should immediately change your {APP_NAME} account password to revoke access from all other locations.

If this was you, you may disregard this email.

Thanks,
{APP_NAME} team

emailTemplate.body:
Hello,

Your one-time password is: {OTP}

If you didn't ask for the one-time password, you can ignore this email.

Thanks,
{APP_NAME} team

listRule:
// Users see their active organization's types; a leaf node mirrors its own organization's types.
(@request.auth.collectionName = "users" && 
organization = @request.auth.current_organization) || 
(@request.auth.collectionName = "leaf_nodes" && organization = @request.auth.organization)
viewRule:
// Users see their active organization's types; a leaf node mirrors its own organization's types.
(@request.auth.collectionName = "users" && 
organization = @request.auth.current_organization) || 
(@request.auth.collectionName = "leaf_nodes" && organization = @request.auth.organization)
deleteRule:
// Only Admins or Owners can delete types.
organization = @request.auth.current_organization && 
(@request.auth.memberships_via_user.organization ?= @request.auth.current_organization && 
 (@request.auth.memberships_via_user.role ?= "owner" || @request.auth.memberships_via_user.role ?= "admin"))
